Hey there! I'm going to Paris on Monday and I was hoping you could help me find a restaurant that serves Chinese cuisine, and opens on Mondays and has prices under 34 euros per person. Can you recommend me the restaurant with the best rating and reviews?
            Tell me the restaurant name, rating, address, the price per person, and the operating hours.

Restaurant in Paris: New Israeli Restaurant
Breizh Café
New Asiaway
Le Baratin
Bistrot Paul Bert
Royal Panda
The yard
China Garden
Miznon
Chez L'Ami Jean

```python
# Get all restaurants in Paris
all_restaurants = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")

# Get the names of all the restaurants
restaurant_names = [restaurant["name"] for restaurant in all_restaurants]

# Get the cuisine type of the restaurants
cuisine_types = get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants(restaurant_names)

# Filter the restaurants that serve Chinese cuisine
chinese_restaurants = [name for name, cuisine in cuisine_types.items() if cuisine == "Chinese"]

# Get the rating and reviews of the Chinese restaurants
ratings_and_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(chinese_restaurants)

# Get the addresses of the Chinese restaurants
addresses = get_restaurants_address(chinese_restaurants)

# Get the price per person of the Chinese restaurants
prices = get_price_for_restaurants(chinese_restaurants)

# Get the operating hours of the Chinese restaurants
operating_hours = check_restaurant_opening_hours(chinese_restaurants)

# Filter the Chinese restaurants that are open on Mondays and have prices under 34 euros per person
filtered_restaurants = [
    (name, ratings_and_reviews[name], addresses[name], prices[name], operating_hours[name])
    for name in chinese_restaurants
    if operating_hours[name]["Monday"] != "Closed" and prices[name] < 34
]

# Find the restaurant with the best rating and reviews
best_restaurant = max(filtered_restaurants, key=lambda x: x[1])

# Print the restaurant name, rating, address, price per person, and operating hours
print("Restaurant Name:", best_restaurant[0])
print("Rating and Reviews:", best_restaurant[1])
print("Address:", best_restaurant[2])
print("Price per Person:", best_restaurant[3])
print("Operating Hours:", best_restaurant[4])
```
